content.comment_body: Hello, We are getting started with [company_name] [product_name] and I am interested in purchasing the required software. I noticed it's only offered on DVD format. My laptop does not have a CD/DVD drive— is there a downloadable version? Best regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Currently, the full version is not available for direct download— only upgrades or updates can be downloaded. You might consider buying or renting an external USB DVD drive. Alternatively, if you know someone who can copy the DVD contents onto a USB stick, you can install it that way. Please note, you still need to purchase the physical CD/DVD, as the full version is only sold in that format.
Hi [user_name], I faced the same challenge. I used a network connection and another PC to transfer the software to my laptop.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience difficulties obtaining and installing the full version of [product_name] software, as it is distributed only on physical DVD media while many contemporary laptops lack CD/DVD drives. There are no official downloads for the full version, only for updates or upgrades. Users rely on solutions like external DVD drives, copying data via USB, or using a networked PC to complete the installation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an option to directly download the full version of the software in a format compatible with modern laptops that lack optical drives.
